extensionDescription.message: An opt-in, read-only strategy advisor for OpenFront.io.

richPlayerWarning.message: {name} has a huge amount of gold. Beware of nukes and MIRVs!

abandonedRichPlayerWarning.message: {name} left the game with a huge amount of gold. Free money!

pirateWarning.message: An enemy warship has stolen more than 10 of your trade ships!

inactiveNeighborWarning.message: Your neighbor {name} is inactive. Take their land!

traitorNeighborWarning.message: Your neighbor {name} betrayed another player. Their defense is halved: opportunity to attack!

firstEnemySiloWarning.message: An enemy has built their first missile silo!

advisor_waiting.message: Waiting for your player to spawn.

advisor_catchup.message: Catching up; advice will resume when synchronized.

advisor_unsupported.message: Unsupported client version. Update the extension.

advisor_error.message: Advisor stopped after an error. See DevTools.

strategyChecking.message: Checking current build costs and placements...

strategyUnavailable.message: Advice unavailable on this client. See diagnostic below.

strategyNoBuild.message: No new economic building recommended (existing construction and disabled buildings are excluded).

strategyNoThreats.message: No observed human attacks, overwhelming hostile neighbors, or nuclear threats.

placement_checking.message: Placement checking; no validated location yet.

placement_valid.message: A valid location is marked on the map. Build manually.

placement_not_found.message: No valid location found among sampled sites. Affordability alone does not mean you can build here.

samPrecaution.message: Precautionary infrastructure coverage only. Cooldowns, missile paths and saturation affect interception; a new SAM may not finish before impact.

reason_foundation.message: Heuristic: establish your first City for troop capacity.

reason_capacity.message: Heuristic: grow troop capacity; high reserves favor another City.

reason_trade.message: Heuristic: add coastal trade infrastructure. Income depends on trade partners and routes.

reason_production.message: Heuristic: balance Factories with Ports for trade production. This is not a guaranteed return on investment.

reason_frontier.message: Cover the threatening player's frontier from a setback position; avoid duplicating nearby posts.

reason_coverage.message: Protect economic buildings outside existing completed SAM coverage.

threat_neighbor.message: Potential danger: hostile human neighbor {name} has at least twice your available troops. No attack implied.

threat_capability.message: Nuclear precaution: {name} has an active or constructing missile silo. No launch implied.

threat_missile.message: Missile threat from {name}: observed target or blast area overlaps your territory.

missileThreatWarning.message: Missile threatening your territory from {name}! New defenses may not finish in time.
